neighbours.label: the slot right after 'contains' / 'rich in' that names the substance something contains (nutrients, compounds, drugs)
fire: Green tea contains a natural compound called catechin.
Salmon is rich in protein and healthy fats.
Coffee beans contain caffeine, a mild stimulant.
The leaves of this plant contain a toxic alkaloid.
Lentils are rich in iron, fibre and folate.
Dark chocolate contains the antioxidant flavanols.
Bananas are rich in potassium and vitamin B6.
Garlic contains allicin, which gives it a sharp smell.
quiet: Green tea is brewed with water that is not quite boiling.
Salmon is caught in cold rivers every autumn.
Coffee beans are roasted in large drums before sale.
The leaves of this plant turn red in October.
Lentils are cooked in about twenty minutes.
Dark chocolate is often sold in thin bars.
Bananas are picked green and shipped overseas.
Garlic is planted in the autumn and harvested in summer.
